## Checklist

- [ ] I read the whole diff and can explain every change
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run lint` and `npx tsc --noEmit` pass
- [ ] I played through the change in the app (if players can see it)
- [ ] New text is in both `en.json` and `el.json`
- [ ] Rule changes in `lib/` have a test
- [ ] No new dependencies, network calls or analytics (or explained below)
